title: Trabajo, tierra y desigualdad
goal: Read how the export boom's labor needs were met -- debt peonage tied to land privatization in some regions, mass European immigration in others -- and how land ownership concentrated by 1900.

items: Explain how the "enganche" debt-labor system worked.
State what earlier laws this debt system rested on.
Describe the contrasting labor experience in Argentina, Uruguay and southern Brazil.
Explain what happened to land ownership in several countries by 1900.
Use the pluperfect (había + participle) to mark what had already happened before a later past event.
